name: Black Sabbath

whyMatters.en: Birmingham four-piece from Polka Tulk / Earth to Black Sabbath. The 1970 debut through Sabbath Bloody Sabbath set down-tuned riffs and bleak lyric frames that later metal catalogs still cite; Heaven and Hell (1980) with Ronnie James Dio (ex-Rainbow) restarted the band after Ozzy left.
whyMatters.zh: 伯明翰四人组，由 Polka Tulk / Earth 更名为 Black Sabbath。1970 年首专至《Sabbath Bloody Sabbath》确立降调 riff 与阴郁歌词框架，后来金属曲目仍常引用；Ozzy 离队后，前 Rainbow 主唱 Ronnie James Dio 参与的《Heaven and Hell》（1980）让乐队重新站稳。

note.en: Title track from the 1970 debut (UK Top 10). Tritone riff and slow tempo; early metal reference track.
note.zh: 1970 年首专同名曲（英榜前 10）。三全音 riff 与慢速度；早期金属参照曲。

note.en: UK #1 album Paranoid; short radio-length single. Same LP includes Planet Caravan and War Pigs.
note.zh: 专辑《Paranoid》英榜冠军；短时长电台单曲。同碟还有《Planet Caravan》《War Pigs》。

note.en: Dio (ex-Rainbow) era; after Ozzy’s 1979 exit and a brief Craig Gruber bass stint. Proves the band still worked without the founding singer.
note.zh: Dio（前 Rainbow）时期；Ozzy 1979 年离队、Craig Gruber 短暂司贝斯之后。证明无创始主唱乐队仍能成立。

note.en: Ian Gillan (ex–Deep Purple) on vocals. Tour used the oversized Stonehenge stage set often linked to Spinal Tap’s mockumentary gag.
note.zh: 主唱为前 Deep Purple 的 Ian Gillan。巡演「巨石阵」舞台布景常与《This Is Spinal Tap》里的同梗对照。

interviewQuotes.text: We knew we had something different.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Tony Iommi

interviewQuotes.text: The tritone was the devil's interval. We just made it a riff.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Geezer Butler

lyricQuotes: What is this that stands before me?
Iron man / Has won the war

shortBio.en: Iommi / Osbourne / Butler / Ward from Birmingham. Paranoid-era foundation for heavy metal; Dio (ex-Rainbow) and later Gillan/Hughes (ex–Deep Purple) eras kept the name alive.
shortBio.zh: 伯明翰 Iommi / Osbourne / Butler / Ward。《Paranoid》时期为重金属奠基；Dio（前 Rainbow）与后来的 Gillan/Hughes（前 Deep Purple）时期延续乐队名。

body.en:
Black Sabbath formed in Birmingham as Polka Tulk, then Earth, before taking the Black Sabbath name with the 1970 debut. Ozzy Osbourne, Tony Iommi, Geezer Butler, and Bill Ward recorded Black Sabbath, Paranoid, Master of Reality, Vol. 4, and Sabbath Bloody Sabbath—early LPs that went gold and later platinum, and that later metal acts from Metallica to Slayer still cite.

Management problems, drugs, and drink fragmented the late-1970s band. After Sabotage (1975), Technical Ecstasy (1976), and Never Say Die! (1978), Osbourne was fired in 1979 (Dave Walker briefly sat in). Butler left briefly; Rainbow’s Craig Gruber filled bass before Butler returned. Ronnie James Dio (ex-Rainbow) joined for Heaven and Hell (1980) and Mob Rules (1981) with Vinny Appice after Ward exited. Dio and Appice left to form Dio; Iommi and Butler then cut Born Again (1983) with Ian Gillan (ex–Deep Purple). Seventh Star (1986) was issued as Sabbath with Glenn Hughes (also ex–Purple) on vocals. Later seats included Tony Martin, Cozy Powell (ex-Rainbow), Eric Singer (later Kiss), Terry Chimes (ex–The Clash), and Bobby Rondinelli (ex-Rainbow). Classic-lineup reunions and the Heaven & Hell project with Dio followed into the 2000s.
body.zh:
Black Sabbath 在伯明翰先以 Polka Tulk、再以 Earth 活动，随 1970 年首专正式使用现名。Ozzy Osbourne、Tony Iommi、Geezer Butler、Bill Ward 录制了《Black Sabbath》《Paranoid》《Master of Reality》《Vol. 4》《Sabbath Bloody Sabbath》——早期金/白金唱片，Metallica、Slayer 等后来金属乐队仍常引用。

管理问题与毒品、酗酒使 1970 年代后期阵容松动。《Sabotage》（1975）之后，《Technical Ecstasy》（1976）与《Never Say Die!》（1978）勉强维持，1979 年 Osbourne 被解雇（Dave Walker 曾短暂顶替）。Butler 一度离队，Rainbow 的 Craig Gruber 补贝斯，Butler 回归后前 Rainbow 主唱 Ronnie James Dio 加入，录制《Heaven and Hell》（1980）；Ward 离队后 Vinny Appice 参与《Mob Rules》（1981）。Dio 与 Appice 离队组建 Dio；Iommi、Butler 再邀前 Deep Purple 的 Ian Gillan 录制《Born Again》（1983）。《Seventh Star》（1986）名义上为 Sabbath，主唱为前 Purple 的 Glenn Hughes。之后还有 Tony Martin、前 Rainbow 鼓手 Cozy Powell、后去 Kiss 的 Eric Singer、前 The Clash 的 Terry Chimes、前 Rainbow 的 Bobby Rondinelli 等。2000 年代有经典阵容重聚，以及 Iommi/Butler 与 Dio、Appice 的 Heaven & Hell 计划。

title.en: Early albums as a metal standard
title.zh: 早期专辑成为金属标准

body.en:
The first six studio albums—especially Black Sabbath through Sabbath Bloody Sabbath—fixed down-tuned riffs, slow-to-mid tempos, and lyric frames about war, dread, and occult imagery.

Osbourne’s harmonica on The Wizard, the quiet Planet Caravan on Paranoid, and Rick Wakeman’s keys on Sabbath Bloody Sabbath show range beyond one tempo.

Ward and Butler’s jazz-leaning rhythmic ideas sit under Iommi’s riff writing.
body.zh:
前六张录音室专辑——尤其从首专到《Sabbath Bloody Sabbath》——确立了降调 riff、中慢速度，以及战争、恐惧与神秘意象的歌词框架。

Osbourne 在《The Wizard》吹口琴、《Paranoid》上的安静曲《Planet Caravan》，以及 Rick Wakeman 在《Sabbath Bloody Sabbath》的键盘，显示不止一种速度。

Ward 与 Butler 偏爵士的节奏想法托在 Iommi 的 riff 写法之下。

title.en: Ozzy years: Earth to Never Say Die!
title.zh: Ozzy 时期：Earth 到 Never Say Die!

body.en:
After European dates as Earth, the debut Black Sabbath (1970) hit the UK Top 10. Paranoid (1970), Master of Reality (1971), Vol. 4 (1972), and Sabbath Bloody Sabbath (1973) followed as gold, later platinum, sellers.

Sabotage (1975) still works; Technical Ecstasy and Never Say Die! mark the fraying end of the Osbourne studio run before the 1979 split.
body.zh:
以 Earth 在欧洲巡演后，首专《Black Sabbath》（1970）进入英榜前 10。《Paranoid》（1970）、《Master of Reality》（1971）、《Vol. 4》（1972）、《Sabbath Bloody Sabbath》（1973）相继成为金唱片，后认证白金。

《Sabotage》（1975）仍站得住；《Technical Ecstasy》与《Never Say Die!》已是 Osbourne 录音室时期松动的尾声，直至 1979 年分裂。

alt.en: Black Sabbath original lineup, 1973 publicity photo
alt.zh: Black Sabbath 创始阵容，1973 年宣传照

title.en: Dio from Rainbow; Heaven and Hell
title.zh: 来自 Rainbow 的 Dio；Heaven and Hell

body.en:
In 1979 Butler briefly left; Rainbow bassist Craig Gruber filled in. Ronnie James Dio left Rainbow for Sabbath vocals. Heaven and Hell (1980) and Mob Rules (1981) restored commercial and critical weight.

Ward’s drinking forced Appice onto the Mob Rules tour. Tension peaked around Live Evil (1983); Dio and Appice left to form Dio.

Shared personnel with Rainbow (Dio, Gruber, later Powell and Rondinelli) is a clear cross-band thread.
body.zh:
1979 年 Butler 短暂离队，Rainbow 贝斯手 Craig Gruber 顶替。Ronnie James Dio 离开 Rainbow 担任 Sabbath 主唱。《Heaven and Hell》（1980）与《Mob Rules》（1981）恢复商业与评价重量。

Ward 酗酒后 Appice 接手《Mob Rules》巡演。《Live Evil》（1983）录制前后关系破裂，Dio 与 Appice 离队组建 Dio。

与 Rainbow 的人员交叉（Dio、Gruber，以及后来的 Powell、Rondinelli）是明确的跨乐队线索。

title.en: Gillan, Hughes, and the Stonehenge tour

body.en:
Born Again (1983) pairs Iommi and Butler with Ian Gillan from Deep Purple. Ward quit again when the oversized Stonehenge set went up; Bev Bevan (Electric Light Orchestra) replaced him on that tour.

Seventh Star (1986) is often read as an Iommi solo record issued under the Sabbath name, with Glenn Hughes (also ex–Deep Purple) on vocals.

Live Aid 1985 briefly reunited Osbourne, Iommi, Butler, and Ward.
body.zh:
《Born Again》（1983）是 Iommi、Butler 与 Deep Purple 的 Ian Gillan 合作。巨石阵舞台立起后 Ward 再次退出，由 Electric Light Orchestra 的 Bev Bevan 顶替巡演。

《Seventh Star》（1986）常被看作以 Sabbath 名义发行的 Iommi 个人向专辑，主唱为同属前 Deep Purple 的 Glenn Hughes。

1985 年 Live Aid 上 Osbourne、Iommi、Butler、Ward 短暂重聚。

alt.en: Black Sabbath at Madison Square Garden, 1977
alt.zh: Black Sabbath 于麦迪逊广场花园，1977

body.en:
Faster riff and shorter runtime than the title track Black Sabbath, still heavy and down-tuned.

UK chart peak for the album; the single length fits radio while keeping the early Sabbath guitar tone.
body.zh:
riff 比同名曲《Black Sabbath》更快、时长更短，仍保持降调与重量。

专辑英榜成绩峰值；单曲时长适合电台，同时保留早期 Sabbath 吉他音色。

title.zh: Martin 时期、重聚与 Heaven & Hell

body.en:
Tony Martin fronted The Eternal Idol (1987), Headless Cross (1989), and TYR (1990) with Nicholls, Powell, and Iommi. Dehumanizer (1992) briefly reunited Dio, Butler, and Appice; Rob Halford (Judas Priest) covered some live dates after Dio left.

Cross Purposes (1994) used Bobby Rondinelli (ex-Rainbow). Forbidden (1995) closed the mid-1990s contract run. Classic-lineup Reunion (1998) and Ozzfest dates followed; Iommi and Butler later worked with Dio and Appice as Heaven & Hell until Dio’s death in 2010.
body.zh:
Tony Martin 主唱《The Eternal Idol》（1987）、《Headless Cross》（1989）、《TYR》（1990），与 Nicholls、Powell、Iommi 合作。《Dehumanizer》（1992）短暂重聚 Dio、Butler、Appice；Dio 离队后 Judas Priest 的 Rob Halford 顶过部分现场。

《Cross Purposes》（1994）用前 Rainbow 鼓手 Bobby Rondinelli。《Forbidden》（1995）结束 90 年代中期合同期。之后有经典阵容《Reunion》（1998）与 Ozzfest；Iommi、Butler 再与 Dio、Appice 以 Heaven & Hell 活动，直至 Dio 2010 年去世。

note.en: Polka Tulk / Earth → Black Sabbath. Debut through Never Say Die!; Paranoid-era peak.
note.zh: Polka Tulk / Earth → Black Sabbath。首专至《Never Say Die!》；《Paranoid》时期峰值。

note.en: Dio from Rainbow. Heaven and Hell / Mob Rules; Appice after Ward leaves.
note.zh: Dio 来自 Rainbow。《Heaven and Hell》/《Mob Rules》；Ward 离队后 Appice 顶替。

note.en: Ian Gillan from Deep Purple. Stonehenge tour stage; Bevan (ELO) on drums for part of the run.
note.zh: Ian Gillan 来自 Deep Purple。巨石阵舞台巡演；部分场次鼓手为 ELO 的 Bevan。

note.en: Eternal Idol / Headless Cross / TYR; Powell and Rondinelli both ex-Rainbow.
note.zh: 《Eternal Idol》/《Headless Cross》/《TYR》；Powell 与 Rondinelli 均来自 Rainbow。

note.en: Tritone opening; early metal reference track from the UK Top 10 debut.
note.zh: 三全音开场；英榜前 10 首专上的早期金属参照曲。

note.en: Heaviness from interval, tempo, and lyric frame—not volume alone. Dio and Purple crossovers keep the later catalog tied to Rainbow and Deep Purple.
note.zh: 「重」来自音程、速度与歌词框架——不只是音量。Dio 与 Purple 人员交叉使后期曲目与 Rainbow、Deep Purple 相连。
